name: Apex Roofing
headline: Roofing in Austin, done properly.
subline: Replace this line with what this business actually promises. Twenty words maximum.

services.title: Roof repair
services.body: Leaks, storm damage and missing shingles, usually fixed in a single visit.

services.title: Full replacement
services.body: Tear-off and re-roof with a written warranty on both labour and materials.

services.title: Gutters
services.body: Cleaning, repair and replacement, including guards that actually keep leaves out.

services.title: Free inspection
services.body: We photograph the whole roof and show you what we found, not just a quote.

services.title: Insurance claims
services.body: We document storm damage properly so the claim goes through the first time.

services.title: Emergency tarping
services.body: Same-day cover to stop water getting in while the repair is scheduled.

process.label: Call us
process.body: Tell us what you are seeing. We will say straight away if it is urgent.

process.label: Free inspection
process.body: We go up, photograph everything, and show you the damage ourselves.

process.label: Fixed quote
process.body: Written, itemised for labour and materials, and it does not move.

process.label: Work and cleanup
process.body: We finish, we walk it with you, and we take every nail off your driveway.

faq.q: How fast can you come out?
faq.a: For active leaks, usually the same day. For scheduled work we are typically booking one to two weeks out, and we will tell you honestly which one you are.

faq.q: Do you handle the insurance paperwork?
faq.a: Yes. We document the damage with dated photographs and write the scope in the format adjusters expect, which is usually what decides whether a claim is approved.
Small repairs typically run a few hundred dollars. A full replacement depends on square footage, pitch and material, and we quote it in writing after the inspection, never over the phone.

faq.q: How long does a roof take?
faq.a: Most homes are a one to two day job once materials are on site. Weather is the only thing that reliably moves the date.

band.headline: Water coming in? We can tarp it today.
band.body: Emergency cover stops the damage spreading while we schedule the repair. Call and we will tell you the price before we drive out.
